QuestInfo.name: Making Sparkling Rock
QuestInfo.1: #p510# looked genuinely surprised when I handed her all the materials she needed to make the #b#t4031011##k. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she made a #b#t4031011##k with the materials I gathered and gave it to me. The #b#t4031011##k... gives off this strange light and... the way it glitters... I can understand why someone would want one of these! It's mesmerizing! Well, now I just have to trade it with #p102# in #m10000000#.
QuestInfo.2: #p510# was startled when she saw I had gotten #b#t4031010##k, and she made me a #b#t4031011##k with it. Now then, should I go back to #p102# in #m10000000#?

0.0: Here, take this #b#t4031011##k. What do you plan on doing with it? It is a special item, indeed, but unless you're collecting stones, it's sort of useless...

1.0: Ohhh... This... It's a #b#t4031011##k!! How did you get this? That's just incredible! How about trading that stone with me? I'll give you the #b#t4031009##k in return!

npc.0: What will you do with the #b#t4031011##k? That stone is coveted by many, but so many materials are needed to make it that you're actually the first one to ever gather all of them. Hopefully you'll put it to good use...

item.0: Didn't get the #b#t4031011##k yet? Oh well, it's not the easiest thing to acquire. Ah, it's so gorgeous when it shines like a star... Hurry and go see #b#p510##k at the general store in #b#m10004000##k.

lost.0: Here, take this #b#t4031011##k. What do you plan on doing with it? It is a special item, indeed, but unless you're collecting stones, it's sort of useless...
